usedFor: ResourceGuru schedules resources and Calendly offers booking links, so “New or Updated Booking” can feed “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated Booking” in ResourceGuru, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A booking change in ResourceGuru is the cue to send the person a way to rebook.

watchOut: “New or Updated Booking” also fires on deletions, so a removed booking can still create a link.
